description: This Python module defines a utility class `FunctionSchema` for representing and managing function schemas, primarily aimed at defining tools and functions for AI models in a standardized way. It includes methods for initializing schema objects, converting them to dictionary format, and accessing individual schema attributes such as name, description, properties, and required parameters.
